items.description: The film from director Gossip Goblin will appeal the decision and is still planning an awards qualifying run in theaters beginning December 4.

items.title: ATC Music Group to acquire the UK’s One Media iP for $20M, secures conditional facility of up to $133M from Corrum Capital to buy more music rights
items.author: Murray Stassen
items.description: Acquired business to be rebranded as ATC Rights; former Round Hill Music Global COO Steve Clark joining as its Managing Director Source

items.author: Murray Stassen
items.description: UMG's Michael Nash also says adoption of Tencent Music's Super VIP tier is now "approaching or surpassing" 20%. Source
